vars.objective: Descend into the Drowned Undercroft and find the Choir's sunsalt stores.
journal: Aurenne is ash. The bells are silent. And Ilse is alive. She runs a hospital here — and I have no idea what I'm going to say to her.
Ilse wouldn't look at me. Forty-one patients with Gloam-rot, and the medicine is somewhere under the Cathedral. I can at least carry water.
Pell is here. Pell from home. The rot nearly took him and Ilse used the last of the medicine. We're going into the Undercroft — "for the patients, not for you." I'll take it.
Sorrel opened the Undercroft for Ilse. Not for me. That's fair. Everybody here would follow Ilse into the dark. I have to earn it.
